content.short: Blockdaemon runs institutional node, staking and custody infrastructure across many networks.
content.description: Blockdaemon supplies node and staking infrastructure to financial institutions, covering custody, tokenization, staking, payments and settlement. Its Institutional Vault is a self-hosted MPC wallet for hot and cold storage, while Builder Vault lets a team assemble a custom wallet on-premise or in the cloud, both with granular key governance controls. Reporting APIs aggregate, normalize and export chain data, and produce audit-ready statements for staking rewards and tokenized vault analytics. Both Monad's and Robinhood Chain's documentation list it among supported RPC providers.
